name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Rotating Picture Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality acrylic for a clear, sturdy, and durable display.
    - Includes 2 acrylic base pieces with 3mm thickness each piece for stable support.
    - Features a smooth rotating mechanism that helps the picture frame move and spin easily.
    - Comes with double-sided adhesive tape dots for secure attachment of selected pieces.
    - Printed acrylic surface offers a clean, polished, and eye-catching look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall product size: 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.
    - Main piece maximum size: 4.97 x 5.25 in ~ 12.62 x 13.34 cm.
    - Custom piece minimum size: 2 cm.
    - Includes 2 double-sided adhesive tape dots with a diameter of 1 cm ~ 0.39 in.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Support frame: 2-sided printing.
    - Rotating plate: 1-sided printing.
    - Main piece: 2-sided printing.
    - Custom piece: 2-sided printing.
    - Base 1: 2-sided printing.
    - Base 2: 1-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized acrylic rotating picture frame for displaying custom artwork, names, and themed designs.
    - Rotating structure adds a fun, interactive, and eye-catching effect to the display.
    - Suitable for use as a tabletop decoration in bedrooms, living rooms, offices, or study spaces.
    - Ideal for seasonal décor, family-themed décor, Halloween décor, and personalized keepsakes.
    - Custom pieces can help create a layered and more vivid visual presentation.
    - Compact size makes it easy to place on desks, shelves, counters, or display tables.
    - A decorative piece that combines personalization and motion for a more unique display experience.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for Halloween, Christmas, birthdays, and other seasonal celebrations.
    - Great for family gifts, friends, kids, and loved ones who enjoy personalized décor.
    - A fun gift idea for housewarming parties or room decoration.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves custom acrylic keepsakes and themed ornaments.
    - Perfect for creating memorable gifts with custom names, characters, or meaningful designs.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Rotating Picture Frame

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
